reviewQuestions.question: Some people prepare a meeting place. Others bring materials or help with food. Why is this cooperation?
reviewQuestions.optionA: Everyone must have the same role and place in society.
reviewQuestions.optionB: People do different tasks to help the same gathering.
reviewQuestions.optionC: Only the largest group has a responsibility.
reviewQuestions.optionD: The work proves that every community followed the same practices.
reviewQuestions.explanation: The groups do different tasks for the same purpose. Working together does not mean everyone had the same rights.
reviewQuestions.learningPoint: Different tasks can support the same goal. Cooperation does not mean everyone has the same role, rights, or freedom.
reviewQuestions.historicalClue: The groups do different tasks for the same purpose. Working together does not mean everyone had the same rights.

answerExplanations.C: People bringing materials and helping with food also contribute. More than one group has a responsibility.
